questions_text_ck.name: questions_text_ck
questions_text_ck.value: "questions"."text_en" IS NOT NULL OR "questions"."text_hi" IS NOT NULL

sessions_subject_ck.name: sessions_subject_ck
sessions_subject_ck.value:
("sessions"."subject_type" = 'ADMIN' AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."candidate_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."student_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("sessions"."subject_type" = 'CANDIDATE' AND "sessions"."candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."student_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("sessions"."subject_type" = 'STUDENT' AND "sessions"."student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."candidate_id" IS NULL)

student_entitlements_target_ck.name: student_entitlements_target_ck
